source_refs.note: Exercise 14.1, Question 7: book page 267 (PDF 272); answer key PDF 311 (book page 306).

blocks.prompt: 7 If \(\underline{u} = x\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + y\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = -2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j}\) represent the sides of a triangle, find the value of \(x\) and \(y\).
blocks.explanation:
Teen vectors ek triangle ki teen sides hain. Triangle law of addition kehta hai: agar aap pehle \(\underline{u}\) par chalein phir \(\underline{v}\) par, to aap wahin pohanchte hain jahan seedha \(\underline{u} + \underline{v}\) par chal kar pohanchte. Yani teesri side baqi do ka jama hai.
Diya kya hai? Teeno vectors, jin mein do unknowns \(x\) aur \(y\) hain.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) aur \(y\).
Plan: \(\underline{w} = \underline{u} + \underline{v}\) le kar components compare karenge. Ek vector equation se teen aam equations bante hain (har direction ki ek).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = x\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + y\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = -2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\) triangle ki sides hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) aur \(y\).
Tareeqa: Triangle law: \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ko head to tail rakhein (ek ka sira dusre ki dum se mile) to teesri side \(\underline{w} = \underline{u} + \underline{v}\) hai. Do vectors tabhi barabar hain jab un ke teeno components barabar hon. \(\underline{w}\) mein \(\underline{k}\) nahi, is liye us ka \(\underline{k}\) component 0 likha.

\(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) jama karein
\[\underline{u} + \underline{v} = (x + 1)\underline{i} + (2 + y)\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + (3 - 3)\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Milte julte components jama kiye. \(x\) aur \(y\) abhi maloom nahi, is liye woh brackets ke andar hi rehte hain: \(x + 1\) aur \(2 + y\).

\(\underline{w}\) ke barabar rakh kar compare karein
\[\underline{i}: x + 1 = -2\]
\[\underline{j}: 2 + y = -3\]
\[\underline{k}: 3 - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Do vectors barabar tab hote hain jab \(\underline{i}\) se \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\) se \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) se \(\underline{k}\) wale parts barabar hon. \(\underline{k}\) wali equation \(0 = 0\) khud hi sahi hai, iska matlab hamara chuna hua arrangement mumkin hai. (Agar \(\underline{u} = \underline{v} + \underline{w}\) lete to \(\underline{k}\) mein \(3 = -3\) aata, jo naamumkin hai.)

Solve karein
\[x = -2 - 1 = -3\]
\[y = -3 - 2 = -5\]
Kyun: Har equation mein sirf ek unknown hai. Number ko dusri taraf le gaye to sign badal gaya: \(+1\) dusri taraf \(-1\), \(+2\) dusri taraf \(-2\).

Tasdeeq
\[\underline{u} = -3\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{u} + \underline{v} = -2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} = \underline{w} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: In values ke saath pehli do sides ka jama bilkul teesri side \(\underline{w}\) ban gaya, to jawab sahi hai.

Doosra arrangement
\[\underline{u} + \underline{v} + \underline{w} = \underline{0}\]
\[\Rightarrow x - 1 = 0,\ y - 1 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow x = 1,\ y = 1\]
Kyun: Sawal yeh nahi batata ke sides kis tarah rakhi hain. Agar teeno ko triangle ke gird ek hi ghoomte rukh mein head to tail rakhein to aap wapas shuru wali jagah aa jate hain, is liye jama zero vector hota hai. Is se \(x = 1,\ y = 1\) aata hai (\(\underline{k}\): \(3 - 3 + 0 = 0\) yahan bhi theek). Kitab ki answer key \(\underline{w} = \underline{u} + \underline{v}\) wala jawab deti hai.
Dhyan dein: exam mein pehli line mein likh dijiye ke aap kaunsa relation le rahe hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x = -3,\ y = -5\) (\(\underline{w} = \underline{u} + \underline{v}\) le kar, jaise answer key mein hai; \(\underline{u} + \underline{v} + \underline{w} = \underline{0}\) lein to \(x = 1,\ y = 1\))
Jo relation lein, woh saaf likhiye.
